instruction: Please take a screenshot from this video and save it as 'snapshot.png' in the video's directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot using VLC. The evaluator checks if snapshot.png file was created as a valid image with reasonable size (> 1KB). Similar complexity to original subtitle extraction task.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: File exists (40%), is valid image (40%), size > 1KB (20%)
